THE MAKING OF THE MAGIC

Give paper
a moving part.

Use the supplied targets, or compile a new page below. Nothing is uploaded.

1 / Compile a target

Choose the exact flat image you will print. Keep its borders and aspect ratio unchanged.

2 / Define the playback area

Edit the campaign’s rectangle in campaigns.json. Coordinates use the full target image, from 0 to 1, with the origin at the top left. The supplied setting covers the full printed frame.

3 / Print a new AR QR code

The old QR codes open videos. Generate new codes for your deployed AR routes. Changing a QR inside an image changes the target: compile the final artwork again before printing.

Before you print

The black Canal+ frame has very few visual features. Its small QR and logo may be insufficient to lock reliably. Choose a detailed campaign frame or include the surrounding case study layout and compile that exact final page.

Print matte, avoid glare, and test on real iOS Safari and Android Chrome devices.
